$description: BrandCloud motion tokens. Source of truth for CSS (--brand-motion-*), Tailwind v4, Motion (React), Svelte and React Native Reanimated presets. Durations in ms, distances in px, springs as physical stiffness/damping/mass so every platform gets the same feel.

instant.$description: Press-down feedback, checkbox ticks. Feels immediate.

fast.$description: Hover, focus, small state changes. Matches @brandcloud/tokens duration-fast.

normal.$description: Default UI transition: menus, popovers, tabs. Matches @brandcloud/tokens duration-normal.

slower.$description: Page and view transitions, the rare section reveal. The ceiling for any UI move.

count.$description: Number count-up only. Not for movement.

standard.$description: Default for things that change state in place.

exit.$description: Accelerate: things leaving. Pair with a shorter duration than the enter.

move.$description: Symmetric: an element travelling from A to B on screen.

press.$description: Button press and release. Quick with a small, physical overshoot on release.

snappy.$description: Default UI spring: toggles, tabs indicator, hover lift. Almost no overshoot.

gentle.$description: Dialogs, drawers, sheets. Settles softly, no bounce.

bouncy.$description: Delight only: one success moment per flow. Never for layout or navigation.

lift.$description: Offer tile and card hover lift.

reveal.$description: Reveal rise. Small on purpose: content settles, it does not fly in.

press.$description: Pressed depth button (the reference depth button value).

pressLarge.$description: Pressed large surface (tile, card, full-width button).

normal.$description: Small groups such as three offer tiles.

maxItems.$description: Items after this index get no extra delay, so a long list never crawls in.

maxUiDuration.$description: No UI movement runs longer than this (count-up and scroll-linked excepted).

maxStaggerTotal.$description: Total stagger delay across a group.

maxConcurrent.$description: Independent animations in view at once (one group counts as one).
